answer_2.quote: We also calculate the mean absolute error (MAE), given in seconds, from the ground truth response offsets to the generated output offsets. ... During training we minimize the binary cross entropy loss (L_BCE) ... The L_KL loss measures the distance of the generated distribution from a Gaussian ...

answer_4.quote: We design an online listening test to answer two questions: ... Participants were asked to make A/B choices between two versions of a turn pair, where each version had a different response offset. ... "Which response timing sounds like it was produced in the real conversation?"
answer_4.guideline: Participants compared response timings (true vs. opposite, true vs. modal) and selected the more realistic sounding timing.
